title: Jeremiah's Lament and the People's Prayer for Mercy
description:
Jeremiah is commanded to let his eyes run with tears night and day over the virgin daughter of his people, who is crushed by an incurable blow.  
On the field lie those killed by the sword, and in the city people are sick from hunger, while both prophet and priest wander through a foreign land.  
The people ask whether the Lord has rejected Judah and grown disgusted with Zion, and they acknowledge their own sin and that of their fathers.  
They pray to God not to reject them or break his covenant, for the sake of his name, and confess that only the Lord—not the empty idols of the nations—can give rain and salvation.
